o.text:
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اوغلان (oġlan), from Proto-Turkic *oglan.
cognates
Cognate with Bashkir улан (olan), Kazakh ұлан (ulan), Tatar олан (olan), улан (ulan), углан (uğlan), Turkish oğlan, Turkmen oglan, Uzbek oʻgʻlon. See also English uhlan.
Likely from Russian га́мбургер (gámburger), from English hamburger.
From Proto-Common Turkic *yapalak, from earlier *yapaku kulak 'furry ears'.
